vintage: NSO Statistical Yearbooks 2025 and 2024; mapped sites

rule.text: A measured district appears when the former province's figure per resident is at least 1.25× Vietnam's (LQ, location quotient): Campus (university students), Commercial hub (retail sales), Industrial zone (FDI registered in 2024) and Tourist quarter (travel and tour turnover): NSO, retail and tourism 2025, FDI 2024 (the last year published for the 63 former provinces), students 2023, each per resident of its own year. A site district needs a mapped site in the province: Harbor (a port), Heritage quarter (a UNESCO World Heritage site), Aerodrome (2M+ passengers), Dam & power plant (1,000+ MW of mapped plants), Government plaza (the capital). Districts are ranked by LQ, a site district counting as LQ 2 (the capital first); up to 5. The badge is the strongest district's.
